## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: narrow tech-led upside with Top 5 all Technology (leadership concentrated), while the majority of sectors (8/11) are negative — mixed signals, style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leading: ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +19.76% | 1M: +34.16%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +9.48% | 1M: +58.85%) ABOVE TREND. Energy and Materials showing selective strength: VLO (1W: +8.78% | 1M: +4.40%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +11.02% | 1M: +27.12%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication, Consumer Staples and Utilities are weakest: GOOGL (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND, CL (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -7.43% | 1M: -16.63%) BELOW TREND. Broad defensive names are not leading, so weakness is concentrated not defensive-led.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) ABOVE TREND; IBM (1W: +19.76% | 1M: +34.16%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +15.45% | 1M: +28.19%) ABOVE TREND; AVGO (1W: +13.60% | 1M: +15.06%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +12.86% | 1M: +51.95%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 all Technology) — concentration risk.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CL (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND; BLK (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -5.83%) BELOW TREND; CEG (1W: -7.43% | 1M: -16.63%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -7.44% | 1M: +17.68%) CORRECTION; GOOGL (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated across Financials, Communication and select defensives.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +19.76% | 1M: +34.16%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.45% | 1M: +28.19%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present: multiple mega-caps (AAPL, INTC, EL, META, TSLA) show 1W weakness vs 1M strength — tactical caution, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is the short-term leader but narrow: Technology (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +16.62%) showing concentrated upside in enterprise, chips and software. Mixed internals: NVDA (1W: +1.01% | 1M: +8.20%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +3.55% | 1M: +3.54%) ABOVE TREND, while AAPL (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +12.18%) CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials lag on the week (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -1.81%) with selective dynamics. JPM (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -2.21%) RECOVERY versus BLK (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -5.83%) BELOW TREND and CME (1W: -9.48% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND — breadth weak, monitor credit-sensitive names.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed/soft (1W: -1.27% | 1M: +1.23%) with regulatory catalysts driving stock-specific moves. LLY (1W: -0.38% | 1M: +11.64%) CORRECTION, JNJ (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +0.14%) CORRECTION, PFE (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.06%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective winners within Technology and Materials (ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +11.02% | 1M: +27.12%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor cyclicals showing momentum. Reduce exposure to weak Financials and large-cap communication/retail laggards (GOOGL (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -8.10%) BELOW TREND) until breadth improves.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +19.76% | 1M: +34.16%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +11.72% | 1M: +28.11%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -8.10%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -12.35% | 1M: -21.97%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (narrow leadership), Energy (XOM (1W: +3.13% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY / CVX (1W: +4.01% | 1M: -0.43%) RECOVERY), Materials (FCX ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Communication, Financials — monitor for spillover if megacap weakness persists.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) ABOVE TREND — watch for follow-through above recent breakouts as confirmation of rotation into enterprise/software. GOOGL (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND — a failure to stabilize would widen sector weakness; NVDA (1W: +1.01% | 1M: +8.20%) ABOVE TREND — watch 1M trend for confirmation of broader tech strength.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+60): Retevmo breakthrough recasts growth story; price CORRECTION — 1W: -0.38% | 1M: +11.64% — news partially confirmed by 1M strength but 1W pullback. CEG (+70): FERC waiver for nuclear restart; price BELOW TREND — 1W: -7.43% | 1M: -16.63% — bullish news but price diverging (watch for catch-up). MA (+55): stablecoin settlement initiative; price BELOW TREND — 1W: -4.75% | 1M: -6.58% — positive catalyst but near-term weakness.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AVGO (-60): AI forecast disappointment headline; price ABOVE TREND — 1W: +13.60% | 1M: +15.06% — negative news but price strength is divergent (distribution risk). TSLA (-45): headline threat; price CORRECTION — 1W: -3.78% | 1M: +7.95% — sentiment aligns with 1W softness. UNH (-45): reimbursement concerns; price CORRECTION — 1W: -1.83% | 1M: +1.69% — watch for earnings/reimbursement flow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +19.76% | 1M: +34.16%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +9.48% | 1M: +58.85%) ABOVE TREND showing strength. Key risk: major divergence across megacaps (GOOGL (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -8.10%) BELOW TREND) and negative headlines on AVGO despite price strength — monitor for distribution.
